title: The buyer
logline: The thrift store from outside, and through the window a stranger carrying the 8×10 black frame to the register, from behind. What's in it: still reserved. Who buys it: from behind. The page lets it go.

panels.composition: A thrift store's front window from the sidewalk, and through it a stranger from behind carrying a black picture frame toward a register, shelves of lamps and dishes.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a thrift store's front window seen from the sidewalk with a stranger seen from behind inside carrying a black picture frame toward a register, shelves of lamps and dishes, no words legible
image.notes: Compare ro_2024-03-17. Contents and buyer reserved.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run

art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
